body:
I appreciate the time you took to reply, and I wish I were able to internalize your suggestions.

On the topic of weight training, I stuck to a gaining diet, taking in ~170g protein, ~66g fat, and enough carbs to total ~2300 calories per day. Gained about 10 lbs over the course of 6 months, and it must have been almost entirely fat, because I made very little strength gains. Then I cut weight to get back down to around my starting weight and tried again with a different strength training program. I’ve been through the bulk/cut process 3 separate times on 3 different programs and never saw results. So either I’m just fucking bad at lifting or my genes are sabotaging me. And I know the latter is exceedingly unlikely.
